$description: GDS semantic tokens, default theme (codex). Aliases point at foundation tokens. Generated from src/tokens/_semantic.scss.

primary.$description: Brand colour of the current product theme (blue in codex, orange in vpplayer). Use for brand marks and accents, not for interactive controls: use action-primary for those.
Fill or text of the main interactive element: primary button, link, selected item, active tab indicator. 4.94:1 on white. One primary action per view.

primary-hover.$description: action-primary on pointer hover. Use only as the :hover state of an element that uses action-primary.

primary-active.$description: action-primary while pressed (:active) or toggled on. Use only as a state of an element that uses action-primary.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons placed on an action-primary fill, such as the label of a primary button. 4.94:1 on action-primary.

primary.$description: Default text: body copy, headings, table cell values, input values. 16.2:1 on white.

secondary.$description: Supporting text that must stay readable: descriptions, subtitles, metadata, secondary table columns, and placeholders inside components. 6.96:1 on white (passes AA).

tertiary.$description: Decorative or repeated text that is not needed to understand the screen. 2.96:1 on white: FAILS WCAG AA as text. Prefer text-secondary for anything a user must read.

disabled.$description: Text and icons of disabled controls only. 2.13:1 on white, allowed by WCAG because disabled controls are exempt. Never use it to make active text look quieter.

placeholder.$description: Legacy placeholder colour, kept for .gds-text-placeholder and as a chip fallback. 2.96:1 on white: FAILS WCAG AA. Components use text-secondary for placeholders since v2.6.2; do not use this for new work.

label.$description: Form labels, table column headers, group titles in menus and panels. 8.5:1 on white.

helper.$description: Secondary icons in components: table sort and row-action icons, tab close icon. 3.59:1 on white: passes the 3:1 minimum for icons, FAILS WCAG AA for text. For helper text under a field use text-secondary.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on dark fills, such as a toast or a dark tooltip. Do not use on white.

primary.$description: Default surface: cards, inputs, modals, menus, table rows. White in the default theme.

secondary.$description: Page background behind cards (gds-page) and hover fill of secondary buttons and calendar days. Text colours keep AA on it except warning-text (4.36:1).

tertiary.$description: Pressed (:active) fill of secondary and ghost buttons, table header and striped rows, current page in pagination, skeleton blocks.

disabled.$description: Fill of disabled inputs and buttons. Pair with text-disabled.

default.$description: Default border of inputs, cards, buttons and dividers. Decorative (1.34:1): never the only cue for a control's edge or state.

strong.$description: Hover border of inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes and radios (.gds-border-hover). 2.96:1 on white, slightly under the 3:1 non-text minimum, so it must not be the only hover cue.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring and focused input border. Every focusable element must show it on :focus-visible. 4.94:1 on white.

subtle.$description: Light separators inside a surface: table row lines, menu and panel dividers, calendar grid.

error.$description: Error fills, icons, dots and borders (input error border, error badge dot). 3.56:1 on white: never use as text colour, use error-text.

error-text.$description: Error messages and error text. 6.31:1 on white.

success.$description: Success fills, icons, dots and borders. 3.97:1 on white: never use as text colour, use success-text.

success-text.$description: Success messages and success text. 6.86:1 on white.

warning.$description: Warning fills, icons, dots and borders. 3.00:1 on white: never use as text colour, use warning-text.

warning-text.$description: Warning messages and warning text. 4.67:1 on white, 4.36:1 on bg-secondary (fails AA there: place warning text on white).
